result.baseline_plan: Measure three representative PRs using existing runner settings: per-job install and test times, total wall time, billed runner-minutes by platform, and failures or retries. Record commit and workload so later experiments are comparable.
result.cache_plan: Identify the package manager, then cache its download store keyed by OS, runtime version and lockfile hash. Keep the existing reproducible install. Compare a cold run and a warm run, including restore/save overhead and billed minutes, before adopting the cache.
result.isolation_investigation: Inspect fixture scope, database naming, migration assumptions, external shared resources and cleanup. Review existing failures without assuming flakiness. Return an isolation design, expected runner usage and a benchmark plan before altering execution.
result.spend_boundary: Measure and propose before increasing spend
